CustomField.description: GDPR role of this partner, which decides which data-protection instrument is actually required. A reseller contracting in its own name is an independent controller and an Art. 28 AVV is the wrong document - signing one misdescribes the relationship and implies a right to instruct that does not exist (cf. EDPB Guidelines 07/2020, Rn. 68). Modelled as a role picklist rather than an AVV-signed checkbox for exactly that reason.
CustomField.label: Datenschutz-Rolle
